card.name: Just before a year's digits
card.fires_on: The space, comma or first digits right before a four-digit historical year (1500s to 1900s) in dates, copyright lines and biographies. It responds at the point where the year is about to be spelled out.

modes.label: Space before year
modes.description: The gap right before a year after words like since, of, or early.

modes.label: Inside copyright years
modes.description: The digit 9 in a 199x year in a copyright range.

modes.label: After day in a date
modes.description: The comma or day digit in a month-day-year date, before the year.
modes.example: was born on August 13<<,>> 1926 in Cuba.

card.writes: It suppresses planet and astronomy words and nudges toward other tokens, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires just before the year is written out in a date, such as a birth date or copyright line.
